title: Getting Down to Business: Chain Ownership and Fertility Clinic Performance
near_miss_reason: Time-varying controls in every reported column: the indicators merger (clinic combined its reporting that year) and first_year (clinic's first reporting year) enter every regression (the covariates X_ct of Equation 1 in the article). Table 2 Panel A pooled columns (chain_join on clinic FE and state-by-year or year FE) have the controls as their sole violation; the acquisition and affiliation columns of Tables 2-3 and Figures 4-6 enter join_acq and join_aff jointly and so fail a further rule. Staggered binary design: clinics join a fertility chain at clinic-specific years 2004-2018 with 415 never-chain control clinics, clinic FE and state-by-year FE. The package ships a synthetic ownership assignment, so no published estimate can be reproduced.
eligible_reason: Design qualifies: clinic-year panel of US fertility clinics 2004-2018 (CDC ART data) in which clinics join a fertility chain by acquisition (33 clinics) or affiliation (28 clinics) at clinic-specific years, with 415 never-chain control clinics, clinic fixed effects and state-by-year fixed effects, clustered by clinic; Sun-Abraham (eventstudyinteract) and stacked (stackedev) event studies are reported alongside TWFE. However, every reported regression includes time-varying indicator controls `merger` (clinic combined reporting that year) and `first_year` (clinic's first year), and the main specifications include two treatment indicators simultaneously (join_acq and join_aff; event studies include the other transaction type's leads and lags as covariates). PROTOCOL.md excludes time-varying controls and additional treatments, so no reported specification is eligible as estimated. Moreover the package does not contain the real treatment data: the ownership file (Pitchbook, SDC Platinum, Irving Levin) is licensed, and 2a_synthetic.do generates a synthetic ownership assignment (random treated clinics and random transaction years); the shipped synthetic_file.dta therefore cannot reproduce any published estimate.
design_notes: 7_main_analysis.do with locals in 00_locals.do: sample (treated==1 | control==1); outcomes lntotal_cycles lntotal_transfers livebrthw (Table 2), birth outcomes by age group (Figure 6), diagnosis shares (Figure 5), pgd_rate icsi_rate embryo_all_trans_w lab_change_all (Table 3); fe_main = i.year#i.state i.clinic_id; fe_year = i.year i.clinic_id; cluster clinic_id; cov_pool = chain_join merger first_year; cov_main = join_acq join_aff merger first_year. Figure 4 event studies: reghdfe y l*_acq p*_acq first_year merger l*_aff p*_aff, absorb(fe_main); eventstudyinteract with cohort(switch_year) control_cohort(control) and the same covariates; stackedev with other_fe(state_year). Table 4: ivreghdfe market-expansion analysis (IV). Real-data log (analysis_replication_mainresults.log): 467 clinics, 5,676 clinic-years in the regression sample; e.g. livebrthw on join_acq 0.0506 (0.0148), join_aff 0.0058 (0.0166).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Real cohort distribution not in package (ownership data synthetic). Synthetic file has switch_year in 2007-2015 (9 cohorts) plus 15 always-chain clinics coded 2003; the real data have 33 acquisitions and 28 affiliations over 2004-2018 per 2a_synthetic.do comments, so at least several cohorts.
